<!DOCTYPE html>
<!-- 文档类型声明：告诉浏览器这是一个 HTML5 文档 -->
<html lang="zh-CN">
<!-- lang="zh-CN" 声明网页语言为中文 -->

<head>
    <!-- ===== 头部信息：给浏览器看的"元数据"，不在页面上显示 ===== -->
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <!-- 字符编码 UTF-8，保证中文不乱码 -->
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <!-- 适配手机：宽度等于设备宽度 -->
    <title>Horooo 的个人主页</title>
    <!-- 浏览器标签页标题 -->

    <style>
        /* ==========================================================
           CSS 样式部分
           ========================================================== */

        /* ---------- 1. 全局基础设置 ---------- */
        * {
            margin: 0;              /* 清除浏览器默认外边距 */
            padding: 0;             /* 清除浏览器默认内边距 */
            box-sizing: border-box; /* 盒模型：宽高包含内边距和边框 */
        }

        body {
            /* 淡粉色渐变背景，营造二次元氛围 */
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffe0ec 0%, #fff0f5 50%, #e6f0ff 100%);
            font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "微软雅黑", sans-serif;
            min-height: 100vh;      /* 占满整个屏幕高度 */
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center; /* 水平居中 */
            align-items: center;     /* 垂直居中 */
            padding: 20px;
            overflow-x: hidden;      /* 防止角色图超出屏幕时出现横向滚动条 */
        }

        /* ---------- 2. 中间的白色圆角卡片 ---------- */
        .card {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            width: 360px;
            padding: 40px 30px;
            border-radius: 24px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(255, 105, 180, 0.18);
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;      /* 形成层叠上下文，确保卡片内容压在角色图之上 */
            z-index: 2;
            animation: card-in 0.8s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes card-in {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px) scale(0.95); }
            to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
        }

        /* ---------- 3. 头像占位符 ---------- */
        .avatar {
            width: 100px;
            height: 100px;
            border-radius: 50%;      /* 50% 圆角：正方形变圆形 */
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffb6c1, #ff9eb5);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 36px;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin: 0 auto 20px auto;
            border: 4px solid #ffd6e0;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }

        .avatar:hover {
            transform: scale(1.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 105, 180, 0.4);
        }

        /* ---------- 4. 名字与自我介绍 ---------- */
        .name {
            font-size: 28px;
            color: #ff6b9d;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .bio {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #a0a0a0;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        /* ---------- 5. 三个链接按钮 ---------- */
        .links {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .btn {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 10px 0;
            border-radius: 999px;    /* 胶囊形按钮 */
            font-size: 14px;
            text-decoration: none;   /* 去掉下划线 */
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .btn-bilibili {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff8fab, #ff6b9d);
            color: #ffffff;
        }

        .btn-douyin,
        .btn-github {
            background-color: #ffffff;
            color: #ff6b9d;
            border: 2px solid #ffd6e0;
        }

        .btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(255, 107, 157, 0.3);
        }

        .btn:active {
            transform: translateY(0);
            box-shadow: none;
        }

        /* ---------- 6. 角色立绘装饰 ---------- */
        /* 通用：固定定位 + 不挡鼠标 + 粉色投影 */
        .holo {
            position: fixed;
            pointer-events: none;      /* 点击穿透，不挡卡片 */
            user-select: none;
            z-index: 1;                /* 在卡片(z-index:2)之下，绝不遮挡中间内容 */
            filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgba(255, 107, 157, 0.25));
            animation: float-sway 5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        /* 左列 */
        .w-holo {           /* 赫萝（花嫁连衣裙）：左侧主力 */
            left: calc(50% - 640px);
            bottom: 20px;
            height: 330px;
            animation-duration: 5s;
        }
        .w-senjougahara {   /* 战场原黑仪 */
            left: calc(50% - 350px);
            bottom: 15px;
            height: 280px;
            animation-duration: 4.2s;
        }
        .w-rei {            /* 凌波丽：左上 */
            left: calc(50% - 400px);
            top: 60px;
            height: 230px;
            animation-duration: 3.6s;
        }
        .w-cc {             /* C.C.：最左上 */
            left: calc(50% - 640px);
            top: 50px;
            height: 190px;
            animation-duration: 4.8s;
        }

        /* 右列 */
        .w-rem {            /* 雷姆：右侧主力 */
            right: calc(50% - 380px);
            bottom: 20px;
            height: 320px;
            animation-duration: 4.5s;
        }
        .w-asuka {          /* 明日香：右上 */
            right: calc(50% - 500px);
            top: 60px;
            height: 280px;
            animation-duration: 3.9s;
        }
        .w-maid {           /* 女仆装赫萝：最右上 */
            right: calc(50% - 640px);
            top: 40px;
            height: 170px;
            animation-duration: 4.4s;
        }

        /* 赫萝的台词气泡 */
        .holo-bubble {
            position: fixed;
            left: calc(50% - 600px);
            bottom: 470px;
            background: #ffffff;
            color: #ff6b9d;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
            padding: 10px 16px;
            border-radius: 18px;
            border: 2px solid #ffd6e0;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(255, 107, 157, 0.15);
            animation: float-sway 5s ease-in-out infinite;
            z-index: 1;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* 气泡的小尾巴：伪元素画的粉色三角 */
        .holo-bubble::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -8px;
            left: 30px;
            border: 6px solid transparent;
            border-top-color: #ffd6e0;
        }

        /* 漂浮动画 */
        @keyframes float-sway {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
            50%      { transform: translateY(-14px); }
        }

        /* ---------- 7. 响应式：保护中间内容 ---------- */
        /* 屏幕不够宽时，先隐藏次要角色，只留左右两大主力（赫萝 + 雷姆）*/
        @media (max-width: 1280px) {
            .waifu-x { display: none; }
        }
        /* 手机/窄屏：隐藏所有装饰，只留卡片 */
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .holo, .holo-bubble { display: none; }
        }
    </style>
<base target="_blank">
</head>

<body>
    <!-- ===== 左侧角色 ===== -->
    <img class="holo w-holo" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="赫萝">
    <img class="holo w-senjougahara waifu-x" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="战场原黑仪">
    <img class="holo w-rei waifu-x" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="凌波丽">
    <img class="holo w-cc waifu-x" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="C.C.">

    <!-- 赫萝的台词气泡 -->
    <div class="holo-bubble">咱可是贤狼赫萝哟~</div>

    <!-- ===== 右侧角色 ===== -->
    <img class="holo w-rem" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="雷姆">
    <img class="holo w-asuka waifu-x" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="明日香">
    <img class="holo w-maid waifu-x" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="女仆装赫萝">

    <!-- ===== 中间的白色圆角卡片 ===== -->
    <div class="card">
        <div class="avatar">Ho</div>
        <h1 class="name">Horooo</h1>
        <p class="bio">编程生万物，这是我的 GitHub 主页</p>
        <div class="links">
            <a href="https://space.bilibili.com/688014628?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0" class="btn btn-bilibili">B站</a>
            <a href="https://www.douyin.com/user/self?from_tab_name=main" class="btn btn-douyin">抖音</a>
            <a href="https://github.com/Horooo1/Horooo-blog" class="btn btn-github">GitHub</a>
        </div>
    </div>

</body>

</html>
